taps.phrase: se retourner vers la classe et sourire

question: Que fait la professeure ?
notes: All three phrases have the same target (the teacher), as in English; the three boxes are identical. The class itself is only on screen in unboxed shots, so the key word appears once, in phrase 3 ('se retourner vers la classe': she turns from the board to face the room/camera). The last boxed frames are a close-up where she stares into the lens (shocked, not smiling); phrase 3 is true of the turn-around frames. 'la professeure' chosen over colloquial 'la prof'.
